profile.headline: Software Developer Team Lead at Computer Aid, Inc.
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Developer and Team Lead with 7+ years of expertise in
communication, information systems, and software development. Seeking to
transition into a Business Analyst role to leverage strong analytical thinking, attention
to detail, and leadership abilities. Proven track record of gathering and analyzing
requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, and driving solutions that meet
business needs and technical requirements. Passionate about optimizing business
processes and ensuring that technical solutions align with organizational goals.
